CONCLUSION.OBSERVATION: Raw gradient conflict was detected in episodes 2, 4, and 5; current-priority projection activated on the same steps and reduced post-projection cosine to numerical zero. Within V14, last1 EV improved in 3 of 4 updates, but paired V10 retention metrics are unavailable. Next-pre EV improved in 1 of 4 pairs (1 tied, 2 worse), with lower mean and median than V10. Current post EV was lower than V10 in episodes 2–5.
CONCLUSION.RECOMMENDED_NEXT_ACTION: Keep V10 scalar/N2 as the current candidate; do not promote V14. Inspect target-scale normalization effective gradient scale and current-group fit before another multi-realization sweep.
CONCLUSION.ROOT_CAUSE_LIMIT: The tested last1 group-balancing + current-priority PCGrad mechanism did not materially improve Fresh5 cross-realization calibration. This does not establish that gradient interference is absent.
